# A guest that boots to a root shell. Played by tests/bin/fake.rs, which
# documents the directives. The text is the fake's own, not a recorded boot.
outln
outln fake PROM: starting the system
outln
outln The system is coming up.
outln
out IRIS console login:\x20
in root
out \r\n#\x20
in uname -m
out \r\nIP27\r\n#\x20
in hinv
out \r\nProcessor 0: 1 MIPS R10000 Processor\r\nMain memory size: 256 Mbytes\r\n#\x20
in halt
outln \r\nThe system is halted.
